logline: A worker bee complains that the giant who keeps stealing her hive's honey plants a row of flowers every time; the flowers spread until she gets lost, and from straight above the meadow is a giant bee with her hive as its heart.
question: why does the giant plant more flowers every time he steals the honey?
premise: A lone beehive on the High Meadow. A giant (a player) has taken its honey 52 times: he lights a campfire under it so the bees stay calm, bottles the honey, then plants a row of flowers. The narrator, a worker bee, thinks he feels bad about stealing. He tells the bees they're his favorite; she's sure he means the honey. He only plants red around the hive (he thinks bees like red). The field keeps growing, the bees fly farther every day, and today she flew so far she couldn't see home.
twist: He isn't paying for the honey: he's drawing them. One row per bottle, 52 rows, the meadow is one huge bee seen from above, and the red ring round the hive is its heart. 'You're my FAVORITE' meant the bees. Cut on the top-down picture.
payoff_note: `top`: the stunt mark when the rising camera settles straight down over the whole bee (S10); the Short ends <= 1.0 s after (owner: cut right on the reveal). No line after L11.
punch_note: hook L01, turn L08 (she sets off to find the edge), the line into the reveal L11

[A friendly teenage boy, bright and goofy]

lines.text: The GIANT / has stolen / our HONEY / FIFTY-TWO times. / And every TIME, / he PLANTS / more FLOWERS.
lines.say: The giant has stolen our honey fifty-two times. And every time, he plants more flowers.
lines.direction: a bubbly complaint, like telling on him; one breath

lines.text: First, SMOKE. / We go all / SLEEPY / and NICE. / We HATE that.
lines.say: First, smoke. We go all sleepy and nice. We hate that.

lines.text: Then CLINK, / honey GONE. / One BOTTLE, / one ROW / of FLOWERS.
lines.say: Then clink, honey gone. One bottle, one row of flowers.
lines.direction: quick and matter-of-fact, counting it off
a little sorry for him, sure of it
bright and goofy, grinning at a tiny bee

lines.text: He plants RED ones / round our DOOR, / so we can / find HOME. / Like we'd EVER / get LOST.
lines.say: He plants red ones round our door, so we can find home. Like we'd ever get lost.
lines.direction: amused, a bit superior, the last word up

lines.text: But the flowers / never END now. / So TODAY, / I went to find / the EDGE.
lines.say: But the flowers never end now. So today, I went to find the edge.
lines.direction: determined and bright, off on an adventure

lines.text: I flew / SO far, / I couldn't / see HOME.
lines.say: I flew so far, I couldn't see home.

lines.text: And way out THERE, / the GIANT, / still PLANTING.
lines.say: And way out there, the giant, still planting.

lines.text: So I'm gonna / go TELL him / we have ENOUGH.
lines.say: So I'm gonna go tell him we have enough.
lines.direction: bossy and fond, the last word up
